newsitem.title: USA: Man kills two, then himself at counselling office.
newsitem.headline: Man kills two, then himself at counselling office.

text.p: A man opened fire on a counsellor and another employee at a social services agency Monday, then went into a back room and killed himself, police said.

The workers, both males, were killed after exchanging words with the unidentified gunman at the downtown Fort Wayne office of Family and Children's Services Inc., an agency run by the United Way Charity that provides counselling.
"He was a client. He had an appointment this morning with these two men that he shot," Ft. Wayne Police Sgt. Bill Walsh said.
The agency, which operates under contracts with local government, provides alcohol and drug counselling and employment counselling as well as play therapy for children.
